title: fix(mcp): a coded sandboxed hook refusal answers the body's sentence, not the wrapper naming the hook
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3apZSKwFDd6zvjM4gJPKAy)_

Fixes #31246

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:沙箱 hook(或 action 主体)抛出带错误码的拒绝时,MCP 的所有工具和记录资源现在只回 hook 作者写的那句话(`Locked.`),错误码和状态码不变;读法用 `/api/v1/data` 同一个函数 `sandboxBusinessMessage`,没有复制逻辑。
- 为什么改:之前 MCP 回的是沙箱调试包装 `hook 'NAME' threw: Error: Locked.`,把 hook 内部名字暴露给 agent;REST 对同一个拒绝只回那句话。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@objectstack/mcp` 的两处读法,patch;非沙箱的带码拒绝逐字不变,沙箱里崩溃的主体也保持原样。回滚即还原这两处。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `thrownRefusalEnvelope`;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` 记录资源的 catch;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 的 #31246 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31246`,预期 16 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A QuickJS hook or action body that runs `throw Object.assign(new Error('Locked.'), { code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', status: 409 })` leaves the runner as a `SandboxError` with `message` = `hook 'NAME' threw: Error: Locked.`, `innerMessage` = `Locked.`, `code` and `status` as declared (measured on the real `QuickJSScriptRunner` at `main` 169ff7e5). MCP rendered `message`, so the agent read the hook's internal name; `/api/v1/data` answers `409 RECORD_LOCKED` with `Locked.` (`mapDataError` → `armSentence` → `sandboxBusinessMessage`).

- `thrownRefusalEnvelope` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) reads `message` as `sandboxBusinessMessage(err) ?? messageOf(err)`. `sandboxBusinessMessage` is the one reader in `@objectstack/types` that the `/data` door uses; there is no second copy of its logic in `packages/mcp`. The code and status are unchanged.
- The record resource's catch (`MCPServerRuntime.bridgeResources`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`) answered a coded refusal with its own `err.message`. It now uses the envelope's `message`, so it gives the same sentence as the tools. The code-less `{ error }` answer is unchanged.

The envelope is the one reader, so every face that renders a coded refusal moves together: the 13 tools (`list_objects`, `describe_object`, `validate_expression`, the six record data tools, `delete_records`, `list_actions`, `run_action`, `resume_run`), the per-row grouping of `delete_records` (`rowRefusalOf`), the record resource, and the object resources' coded refusal (`objectResourceRefusal`).

| Throw | Before (MCP) | Now (MCP) | `/api/v1/data` |
|---|---|---|---|
| coded sandboxed refusal (`RECORD_LOCKED`/409, inner `Locked.`) | `RECORD_LOCKED` · `hook 'demo_guard' threw: Error: Locked.` · 409 | `RECORD_LOCKED` · `Locked.` · 409 | `RECORD_LOCKED` · `Locked.` · 409 |
| CONTROL: coded non-sandbox refusal, including one whose own text reads like the wrapper | its message | its message, byte for byte | (not this card) |

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: a new `#31246` describe on the shared `/mcp` HTTP harness. Each of the 13 tools (the `SITES` table, which is held equal to the registered tool list) answers the coded sandboxed refusal with `{ code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', message: INNER_SENTENCE, status: 409 }`. Each case also checks that this equals `mapDataError`'s answer to the same throw, and that the hook name and `threw` are absent. CONTROL: three coded non-sandbox throws (a plain sentence, a sentence that reads like the wrapper, and a `SandboxError` with an empty `innerMessage`) render byte for byte as `JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message, status } }, null, 2)`. In the record-resource describe: the coded sandboxed refusal answers `{ error: INNER_SENTENCE, code, status }`, and a CONTROL keeps a coded non-sandbox wrapper-like sentence.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-delete-records.test.ts`: a coded sandboxed row refusal is grouped as `{ code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', status: 409, reason: INNER_SENTENCE }`, and the call goes on.

<details><summary>Red first and ablations</summary>

Red first on `bdefd49f` (after PR #31245 merged, before the fix): the two files answered `Tests 15 failed | 91 passed (106)`. The 13 tool rows, the resource row and the `delete_records` row failed; the CONTROLs passed. After the fix: `Tests 106 passed (106)`.

Ablation 1 (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `mcp-http-tools.ts`): `message: sandboxBusinessMessage(err) ?? messageOf(err),` replaced by `message: messageOf(err) as string,`. Output: `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 9cca1c033a19 -> 58b6b2bf2013`, then `Tests 15 failed | 91 passed (106)`, then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (9cca1c033a19) and git diff HEAD is empty`.

Ablation 2 (`mcp-server-runtime.ts`): `error: envelope.message,` replaced by `error: message as string,`. Output: `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 38c17f5605e4 -> c385c405c4f1`, then `Tests 1 failed | 105 passed (106)` (the resource row only), then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (38c17f5605e4)`.

The tests import the package's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

Item 2 of the card: each listed face was measured against the REST door that serves the same verb, using five throws: V1 coded sandboxed refusal, V2 code-less sandboxed abort, V3 bare `Error`, V4 driver string code `SQLITE_BUSY`, V5 coded sandboxed **crash** (inner `TypeError: boom`, code `RECORD_LOCKED`, status 409; the real runner's shape). MCP was measured over `/mcp` on this branch with a bridge member throwing each value. REST was measured with the door's own responder: `mapDataError` for `/data`, `handleRouteError` for `/meta`, and the runtime `HttpDispatcher.handleActions` for `/actions`.

| Face | Throw | MCP answers | REST answers | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| every face | V1 | inner sentence (this PR) | inner sentence | fixed here |
| every face | V5 coded crash | `RECORD_LOCKED` · `hook 'demo_guard' threw: TypeError: boom` · 409 | `/data`, `/meta`: `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error`; `/actions`: 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` | divergence, not fixed by the shared reader (`sandboxBusinessMessage` declines a crash by contract); finding |
| metadata tools, `list_actions` | V3 | bare text `socket hang up` | `/meta`: `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error` | divergence; finding |
| metadata tools, `list_actions` | V4 | `SQLITE_BUSY` · driver text | `/meta`: `500 DATABASE_ERROR` `Internal data error` | divergence; finding |
| record resource | V2 | `{ error: "hook 'demo_guard' threw: Error: Not enough leave" }` | `/data`: `400 HOOK_ABORTED` `Not enough leave` | divergence (the #31218 code-less half on this face); finding |
| record resource | V3 / V4 | `{ error: 'socket hang up' }` / `{ error, code: 'SQLITE_BUSY' }` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` / `500 DATABASE_ERROR` | divergence; same finding |
| `run_action` / `resume_run` | V2 | bare wrapper text naming the body | `/actions`: `400 HOOK_ABORTED` inner sentence | divergence; finding |
| `run_action` / `resume_run` | V3 | bare text, no code | `/actions`: `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` same text | divergence (code only); same finding |
| `run_action` / `resume_run` | V4 | `SQLITE_BUSY` · text, no status | `/actions`: `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` · text · `declaredCode: SQLITE_BUSY` | divergence; same finding |
| record data tools | V4 | `SQLITE_BUSY` · driver text, no status (coded path is read first) | `/data`: `500 DATABASE_ERROR` `Internal data error` | divergence; finding |
| record data tools | V2 / V3 | `HOOK_ABORTED` 400 / `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500 | same | converged by #31218 |
| `delete_records` outer catch | V2 / V3 | bare message | n/a | kept as intended, see below |

Kept as intended: `delete_records`' outer catch stays on `errorResultWithCode`. It also renders this file's own code-less sentences (`delete_records could not read the records the query on 'OBJ' answered`), which `mapDataError`'s unknown-object heuristic would misread as `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` (the PR #31245 note). Its fault answer still quotes the faulting row's thrown message, as `mcp-delete-records.test.ts` pins on purpose. Each divergence above is listed for the seat to file, one card per face.
